# Outer-space plates

1920×1080 flight backdrop for local space. Composite back to front: `starfield_far`, `nebula_soft_a` or `nebula_soft_b`, `starfield_mid`, a station plate (`station_approach`, `station_exterior`, or `dock_bay`), `dust_parallax`, then `sun_disc` / `sun_bloom` / `lens_streak`. MANIFEST and NOTES stay out of the service worker.
